def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_cap = bins - item
    mask = remaining_cap >= 0
    extra_items = np.floor_divide(remaining_cap, item)
    return np.where(mask, 10 * extra_items - remaining_cap, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    mask = bins >= item
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    quotient = remaining / item
    # Favor exact multiples (integer quotients) and smaller multiples
    priorities[mask] = -np.abs(quotient - np.round(quotient)) - quotient
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    mask = bins >= item
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    target = item * ((np.sqrt(5) - 1) / 2)  # golden ratio ~0.618
    priorities[mask] = -np.abs(remaining - target)
    return priorities
